classification.difficultyReason: Extract seven equally spaced heights from an irregular profile and apply the composite trapezoidal rule.

content.prompt: The diagram shows a vertical rock cutting of length 300 metres alongside a straight horizontal section of highway. The heights of the cutting are measured at 50-metre intervals. Use the trapezoidal rule to estimate the area of the vertical rock cutting.

spec.description: Irregular upper boundary above a horizontal baseline; vertical measured heights at 50-metre intervals. Baseline labels are 0, 100, 200 and 300. The final height 3 is outside the right edge. Decorative grey fill is omitted under house diagram conventions.
spec.mathematics: Positions 0,50,100,150,200,250,300 metres have heights 5,10,13,14,11,7,3 metres respectively.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions are permanent question givens; no answer is shown.

answer.worked:
The interval width is $h=50\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{aligned}A&\approx\frac{50}{2}\bigl[5+2(10+13+14+11+7)+3\bigr]\\&=25(5+110+3)\\&=2950\text{ m}^2.\end{aligned}$$
